messages.content:
<document id=DOC_quarterly_q3>
Q3 revenue by region. North America recorded 41.2 million. EMEA
recorded 28.7 million. Japan recorded 11.4 million. Australia recorded
6.1 million. Total revenue was 87.4 million across these four regions.
</document>

Using the quarterly report below, state which single region contributed
the largest share of total revenue, and give that share as a percentage
of the total.

response.text:
North America contributed the largest share of total revenue. Its revenue was 41.2 million out of a total of 87.4 million, which is approximately **47.2%** of the total revenue.

Calculation:  
(41.2 / 87.4) × 100 ≈ 47.2%
